scope: SSOT-only decision and machine-contract projection for repeated Workspace model configuration updates; no production code, generated binding, Candidate, Instance deployment or Tencent resource action.
decisionConclusion: Keep BindSecret as initial-bind/replay. Add Fabric-owned RebindSecret with predecessor CAS and provider readback. Revoke the predecessor Gateway key only after Serve confirms the new model version.
whyNecessary: The existing one-active-binding uniqueness rule is correct for idempotency but cannot represent a legitimate second model configuration. Without an explicit replacement operation, the system would fabricate a binding, drop the uniqueness invariant, or revoke the old key before the new Runtime is confirmed.
whyRequired: DDD requires Workspace to own model intent/version, Gateway to own managed-key issuance/revocation, Fabric to own Secret binding/readback, and Serve to own Runtime apply/readiness. The replacement contract is the smallest owner-separated path that preserves those boundaries.
businessSequence: Workspace validates the new selection and creates a new exact Gateway managed-key binding.
Fabric.RebindSecret compares the expected predecessor and confirms the new Secret through the provider.
Serve applies the new opaque binding and reads back the target applied model version.
Workspace advances applied version through owner-local CAS.
Workspace requests Gateway predecessor-key revocation; Fabric retires the predecessor binding separately.
failureSemantics: Fabric rejection keeps the predecessor Gateway key and does not call Serve.
Serve rejection or unknown does not advance Workspace or revoke the predecessor.
Unknown replacement or compensation is resolved by original operation readback before another side effect.

ownerMap.workspace: model intent, version, CAS, orchestration and predecessor revoke request
ownerMap.gateway: managed-key issuance, Secret delivery reference and key revocation
ownerMap.fabric: provider Secret binding/rebind/readback and binding retirement
ownerMap.instance: Cloud deployment and protected environment, not per-Workspace orchestration
